decisions.q: What the skin changes in the room
decisions.a: Wall and frame
Words with icons

spec: 7 themes: `default` (Forest) + amber, clay, umber, slate, plum, rose
Paste `skins.ts` into `themes.ts`. Status colours and the DANGER modal never change.

golden · fawn · apricot · tan → amber; red · orange · ginger → clay; brown · chocolate → umber; white · cream → umber (decision 2); grey · blue · black → slate; mixed → the largest colour; low confidence → default. Plum and Rose: owner's pick only.
The selected pet's skin, whole app
Switching pets (PetSwitcher) switches the skin; the sitter sees the skin of the pet in their care.
frame: skin primary at 22 % lightness · wall: skin `accent`
`pet-room` · “Max's room. Max looks calm. Fed at 8 AM, potty once, walk at 4 PM.”
Under the stay card on Owner Home. Tap → Activity.
160 tall · radius 12 · window, bowl, bed, floor
fixed room colours; window turns night blue when sleepy
Only the wall takes the skin (decision 6); the sprite is never recoloured.
24 × 24 cells at 4× = 96 pt, centred on the floor
`<pet>-<mood>.png`: Maltese → `max`, other dogs → `dog`, cats → `cat`. Web: `image-rendering: pixelated`.
2 × 2 chips, 30 tall, radius 8, 12 / 600 · 16 px pixel icons
Fed · potty · mood · next task, in words (decision 7). Same facts as the label.
hungry: no meal check-in in 6 h · otherwise the latest mood check-in (happy, calm, tired) · sleepy: a nap check-in in the last hour (proposal) · nothing logged: calm.

title: Moments and Diary: the day first (decided by Minsik)

decisions.a: Proposal for the team; today's app is #340. View tabs approved by Mook (Oct 24)
New component: Photos · Diary as underline tabs that switch the view; pills only for filters
Opens on All pets (each photo carries the pet's face); the first filter chip (All pets ▾) opens a sheet to narrow to one pet; hidden with one pet
Notes and pages name their sitter; Ask for a photo goes to every sitter on the screen
Meals · Walks · Naps chips with Lucide icons; day headers; a mosaic of the latest three. The sitter's notes are on Home, not here (Oct 25)
Full screen; tag, note, time and sender over the photo on a dark fade; one tap hides them, a ring hints it until the first tap; Hide, Edit (own photos), Delete (for both or me) (Oct 25)
Several at once, numbered; All photos for the rest; a note field under the photos; no share pill beside + Photo (Oct 25)
Open any photo: Make a sticker, or press and hold the pet. It lifts off with a white border into your own sticker box (only you see it, decided Oct 25); Put it on the page opens Decorate
Opens on today's pages with the day's photo and today's updates; Decorate opens a tray (the pet's stickers, the Goldito set)
Days · Calendar · Footprints as a Segmented control under the tabs; the chip row under it is the pet and the day, week or month; Calendar and Footprints open a day as a sheet
Moments (decided Oct 25, shipped in #346)
Only on Home (Latest from Chloe), not in Moments (decided Oct 25)

notes: Decided by Minsik (Oct 25)

Picker inside the tabs · All pets together · Moments · Days, Calendar and Footprints · Stickers only for their maker · Ask for a photo only in Chat · Diary pages start shared · The paw menu after the freeze · A little playful
What the app should change

1 Buttons use emoji (✏️ Note, ✏️ Edit, 🔒): words with Lucide icons. FeedViewer, AddPhotoSheet
2 Opened photo is squeezed: details over the photo on a dark fade, one tap hides them. FeedViewer
3 Tap hint: a pulsing ring with "Tap the photo to see all of it" until the first tap. FeedViewer
4 Note field shown under the photos, one line that grows. AddPhotoSheet
5 Several photos at once, numbered; All photos for the rest. AddPhotoSheet, pickMedia
6 "Or press and hold Max" (the pet's name). FeedViewer
Sitter notes
Only on Home (Latest from Chloe), not in Moments (decided Oct 25)

“Slept on the red pillow. Not one cry.”

title: Intro: the first minute (ready to build)

decisions.a: PR #384 (in review with Minsik): Boot, Welcome, How it works, Log in, Sign up, Privacy and Terms
A butter card under the tagline so first-time visitors see it (Mook, Oct 25)
One page: Back, the title with its date, one card per section with a chevron; a small Privacy · Terms line on Welcome
Ready to build, approved by Mook on Oct 25. Today's first run is audited on the page (12 findings)
Try the demo first (as the README promises), then Continue with Apple, Continue with Google, Sign up with email, Log in; How it works under the headline
Three pages: the problem, two roles, one stay (the five stages); real pictures from the app, never placeholder boxes; Skip top right
A sheet picks Robert or Chloe; the paw walk while it opens; a banner says whose phone you're on, with Switch
Who you are, then Apple, Google or email, then a password; one progress bar, one Back
Starts with Let's meet your pet (about 3 minutes, talk or type, stop any time); ends with four paw prints and Welcome to Goldito with the tagline
The same four-print walk as the finish, with the coin and Goldito under it

notes: First-run audit (main, Oct 25)

Tour · Dashed "PHOTO PLACEHOLDER" and "VIDEO PLACEHOLDER" boxes show our production notes to users · High · Fixed
Welcome · No main button and no Try demo; the README's "Try demo → Owner" doesn't exist on the first screen · High · Fixed
Tour · "Get started" goes to Log in, not Sign up · Medium · Fixed
Everywhere · No illustration anywhere before Home · Medium · Fixed
Boot · Coin screen, then a bare spinner, then the app; no native splash set up · Medium · Fixed
Sign up · The "or with email" divider sits off to the right; Terms and Privacy aren't links (#375 added a Terms page on Oct 25) · Medium · Fixed
Welcome, Sign up, Log in · Apple and Google only show "Coming soon". #362 (Oct 25) added their logos on Log in and Sign up; Welcome still has neither. They need to work before judges tap them, or be hidden for the demo · High · Designed · needs code
Log in · No Forgot password; no demo hint · Medium · Fixed
Pet setup · About 30 screens; breed, age and weight asked twice (voice, then again); "Tell us about Max" twice; three kinds of Skip; Back twice · High · Next
Pet setup · No start screen and no finish moment (only a toast) · Medium · Fixed
Sitter setup · Two headers (a native "Your answers" bar over our own); the review screen drops the frame; custom questions has no Skip · Medium · Next
Home · The setup check runs after Home appears, so Home may flash first; if the check fails you land on Home · Medium · Next (code)
Copy · "📍 Use my current location", "+ Add a note", "See owner tour →"; emoji empty states; typo "Pick or skips" · Low · Next

title: Pet tone and dark mode (proposal)

decisions.a: Proposal, Oct 25; seven calls for the team on the page
Only the 11 SkinColors in themes.ts change; error, success, warning, gold and media never do; color blocks get dark values
Goldito green (default), Tint (grounds and highlights follow the pet), Full (buttons too); white, black and grey coats keep green
The same roles in dark; status colors have dark versions; every text pair checked at 4.5:1 (3:1 for outlines)
A tamagotchi only real check-ins move: never sad, rests between stays, a sticker a day on its shelf

notes: Seven calls for the team (recommendations)

1. On by default, or a choice after the first photo? → My pick: a choice
2. The whole app, or just the pet's own screens? → My pick: the pet's screens
3. Tint or Full? → My pick: Tint
4. White, black and grey coats → My pick: keep green
5. Pick once, or follow every new photo? → My pick: once, from the profile photo
7. The color blocks in dark mode → Found while testing
6. Dark mode for the demo? → My pick: System, after the freeze
Tokens

Only the 11 SkinColors in frontend/theme/themes.ts change. Locked: error, success, warning (and surfaces), gold, cream, media. Color blocks need dark values: mint #1F3A2C, peach #3F2C1E, butter #3A3218, blush #40251F. Text on a block is always full strength.

title: UX patterns: rules and 12 calls (decided Oct 25)

decisions.a: Changed the same night: Back is the ← arrow alone everywhere, 44 px, read aloud as Back (PR #393)
Kept the confirm sheet #387 shipped, in the menu and Settings (PR #394)
Decided by Mook, Oct 25: U1 A, U2 C, U3 B, U4 A, U5 A, U6 A, U7 A, U8 B, U9 A, U10 A, U11 A, U12 A. DESIGN.md §7.8, §7.11, §7.12, §7.13 (branch docs/ux-patterns)
Back goes back (chevron + Back, top left, one per screen); Close dismisses (never saves); the primary finishes; typed input is never dropped silently

Field errors under the field; screen problems in a Banner; quick results in a toast with a tone; destructive confirms in a Sheet with a danger button; reversible acts get Undo; disabled buttons say why
One primary per screen via Screen footer; one word per job (Save, Done, Mark done, Next, Send, Accept, Decline, Try again, Skip); sheet buttons in the footer; 44 px targets

notes: The 12 calls

U1 Back on detail screens: A Chevron + Back / B ← arrow only · recommended A
U2 Leaving with something typed: A Keep a draft / B Ask first / C Both · recommended C
U3 How long Undo stays: A 5 seconds / B 6 seconds / C 8 seconds · recommended B
U4 Closing a full-screen photo: A ✕ top left / B ✕ top right / C ‹ top left · recommended A
U5 Signing out: A No confirm / B Confirm in a sheet · recommended A
U6 Where errors show: A By job / B Toasts only · recommended A
U7 Loading a screen: A Skeletons, tab screens after the freeze / B Spinner · recommended A
U8 Browser Back inside a flow: A Steps in the URL now / B After the freeze · recommended B
U9 A notification while your toast is up: A Badge, then queue / B Replace · recommended A
U10 A sheet that applies as you tap: A Done only / B Close and Done · recommended A
U11 Booking detail with several actions: A One primary: the next step / B A primary per card · recommended A
U12 The word for yes: A Accept everywhere / B Keep each one · recommended A

title: Little delights (proposal)

decisions.a: A library to pick from per screen; nothing here is decided except the welcome walk (four prints, bottom to top)
Calm by default; every delight has a still version under Reduce motion; durations 120, 240, 420 ms (DESIGN.md D7)
Paw prints face the way they walk and alternate feet; 22, 30 or 38 px

notes: Every delight

Welcome walk (Prototype): After sign-up, once. Expressive prototype (#splash). Variations: path Bottom to top ★ / Left to right / Diagonal rise / Wander / Circle / Toward you; trail Fade behind ★ / Vanish / Stay; count 4 ★ / 6 / 8; size Small / Medium ★ / Large; color Green ★ / Gold / Peach
Paw loader (New): Any wait over a second: loading photos, writing today's page. Variations: path Walk up ★ / Circle / Across / Wander; count 4 ★ / 6; size Small ★ / Medium; color Green ★ / Gold
Typing paws (New): Chat, while Chloe's assistant writes a reply. Variations: move Hop ★ / Fade / Step in turn; color Green ★ / Gold
Paw progress (New): Uploads and the report draft, when we know how far along it is. Variations: style Prints in the bar ★ / A paw rides the bar / Stamps on the photos
Gold paw stamp (Prototype): Sharing a photo or a diary page. Variations: style Stamp ★ / Stamp and ripple / Seal
Reaction burst (Prototype): Happy and Love it on Latest from Chloe, on Home. Variations: icon Hearts ★ / Paws / Hearts and paws; count 5 ★ / 8
Home safe confetti (New): Stage 5: Max is home safe. Variations: mix Gold paws ★ / Paws and stars / Just a few
Sticker on the shelf (Prototype): Max's room, each night a day of care ends. Variations: move Pop ★ / Drop in / Spin
Care check-off (New): Sitter's Today list: Meal, Walk, Pill. Variations: mark Check ★ / Paw print / Check, then a paw
Toast with a sticker (Prototype): Saved, shared, asked: every small success. Variations: enter Slide up ★ / Pop / From the top; words Paw-fect! / Plain
Button press (Partly in the app): Chips and option cards press today; PressableScale (on a branch, not merged) would bring it to every button. Variations: feel Scale ★ / Squish / Wiggle
Pull to refresh (New): Moments and Home, pulling down. Variations: paw Paw spins ★ / Paws walk on the spot / Paw stamps
Tap to see all (Prototype): Opened photo, until you've tapped once. Variations: ring Pulse ★ / Ripple / Breathing dot
Pet idle moves (Prototype): Max's room and the Home pet card. Variations: move Breathe ★ / Hop / Sleepy / Wag; pet Max / Mochi

title: Sitter Home before the first booking (E: card + trail)

decisions.a: E (card + trail) chosen by Mook, Oct 26; the other variations were dropped
Five steps that open the real screens: setup questions, Profile (photos, About you; house rules and spots; parking and lobby), Schedule. Done only when saved
No rate screen yet (#193): the card shows no price until it exists
A bonus, not part of ready (Mook's lean)
The trail becomes the stay's five stages: Ask, Meet, Book, Care, Home
Built from SitterResultCard, ListRow, CheckRow, Card, Tag, Avatar, MessageBubble, BookingTicket, SummaryRow, SectionTitle, Button and RoleTabs; new: StageTrail and its mini version

decisions.a: Proposal for the team; live Diary is covers, book and History (7 days)

The day strip opens a calendar: a photo behind each day; Day, Week, Month, Year (B)
Footprints: the pet's year as a path with its stickers, for the end of a stay and the pet profile (C)

runs.text: “He sat on my feet the whole time.”
“Slept on the red pillow. Not one cry.”
